build: Development build on localhost, PayPal sandbox, Postgres 17

suites.name: Rules engine and routing
suites.what: Every rule row, the 2026 values, the $60 quarterly exclusion, shelter, ABLE, gift routing, pronouns, and the reviewers’ referee

suites.name: API end to end
suites.what: Gift checks, presets, bill and fundraiser reading, the two reviewers, gift pages, PayPal orders, routed gifts, receipts, the ledger, developer keys and every error path

suites.name: Browser end to end
suites.what: The Gift Checker, Try it, the two reviewers, a fundraiser turned into a gift page, the gift page, keyboard use, and the developer flow

suites.name: Accessibility and layout
suites.what: axe WCAG 2.2 AA on 14 pages, including a generated gift page, at desktop and phone widths, light and dark, with no sideways scroll

suites.name: Real PayPal checkout, logged in as the sandbox buyer
suites.what: Both PayPal buttons: the buyer logs in and approves, PayPal captures every payee, the page updates, and the public receipt matches

suites.name: Failure cases, live
suites.what: Run the eight failure cases on this page yourself
